Waring's guide to the drugs of the Indian bazaar and the plants used in the country's medicine, with their uses and doses (third edition, 1883).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy of the Wellcome Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Remarks on the uses of some of the bazaar medicines and common medical plants of India : with a full index of diseases, indicating their treatment by these and other agents procurable throughout India to which are added directions for treatment in cases of drowning, snake-bites, &c · Waring, Edward John, 1819-1891. n 85830313 · 1883, 294 scanned pages. Published 1883; Edward John Waring died 1891; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
